description: Normalize microservice logs: Pino JSON, plain JSON, and text formats into ECS-compatible log.level

script.description: Normalize log level from Pino numeric, string, or plain-text patterns
Fallback service.name from Docker container metadata
script.source: if (ctx.service == null || !(ctx.service instanceof Map)) { ctx.service = new HashMap(); } if (!ctx.service.containsKey('name') || ctx.service.name == null) { ctx.service.name = ctx.container.name; }
